firstMessage.rawMarkdown: HARNESS_README section 7.2 says the scorer builds EventsCompactionConfig(compaction_interval=15, overlap_size=2, token_threshold=32768, event_retention_size=5). The Getting Started notebook uses token_threshold=14336. With max_model_len=32768 the first value can never trigger, while the second triggers on most multi-step tasks and adds a summarizer call each time. Which value does the scoring run use today?
